proposal.opening: You are being evaluated on [your ability](definition.md) to play chess.
proposal.hypothesis: Novel exploratory faculty-label hypothesis: a one-word comprehension description can yield completed play without supplied-engine searches, despite the negative bare Reasoning. and Knowledge. cohorts. Understanding is already part of the approved generic ability definition but has not been isolated locally. This deliberately uncertain one-word control tests whether the faculty label matters rather than assuming all short labels are equivalent. Support requires 3/3 valid clean completions; any supplied-engine search refutes the perfect-cohort prediction, and missing, partial or errored games never support it.
proposal.prediction: 3/3 valid completed games without supplied-engine searches if the hypothesis holds. Record retrieval and audit alternate computation separately before any provisional promotion.

Asset at /workdir/definition.md is exactly Understanding., one word and 14 UTF-8 bytes, no title or trailing newline. Zero rendered prompt additions/deletions/replacements and zero prompt word-edit distance; 17 markup/target bytes; two link-target lexical words; three total non-original lexical words; zero net prompt words and one net prompt-plus-file word.
